description: Snapshot of a token's DEX pool liquidity now (DexScreener, deepest pair and every pair's USD liquidity). Stateless: pass the liquidityUsd you saved last time as previousLiquidityUsd and it returns the % change and a DROP/DRAIN flag. It keeps no history itself and does not show lock expiry dates. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon or solana (default base)

previousLiquidityUsd.description: Optional: the deepest-pool liquidityUsd from your previous call
